headline: SFG @ ATL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is SFG 4.36 at ATL 4.63, with a projected total of 8.99. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward SFG: SFG moved +0.55 runs while ATL moved +0.12, changing the projected margin by +0.42 runs. The projected total climbed +0.73, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Martín Pérez has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.2 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Luis Arraez, Bryce Eldridge, Michael Harris II, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Drew Gilbert, Jorge Mateo because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
